# TDPdf v2.1.0.0

**Safer redaction and saving, page edits that can't break your document, better printing and forms, and a window that fits your screen.**

## Redaction

- Redaction now also removes comments, links and form fields under a marked area, including what was typed into them. If anything is still under a mark, TDPdf does not write the redacted file.

## Your work stays safe

- TDPdf warns before saving over a file another program changed since you opened it.
- If a save can't finish, a complete copy is kept next to your file and TDPdf tells you where.
- Signing out of or shutting down Windows with unsaved changes now stops and tells you.
- If a page edit (rotate, delete, move, insert, crop and so on) fails, your document is left as it was.
- Extract Page(s) can no longer overwrite the document you're extracting from.
- Deleting the last pages keeps you at the end of the document.

## Printing

- Print, print preview and Save Flattened follow each annotation's print setting.
- Two-sided printing chosen in your printer's Properties dialog is kept.

## Forms and text

- A field that appears in several places shows and saves the same value in every copy.
- Check marks, stars and other symbols in form fields save visibly instead of as empty boxes.
- Hebrew text that contains numbers or English words saves in the order you see on screen.
- Selecting and copying rotated or upside-down text works correctly.

## Window

- TDPdf opens inside the screen on small or high-scaling displays, and has a minimum size so the footer is never cut off.
- Right-click the title bar, or press Alt+Space, for the window menu.
- The maximize button shows the restore icon while maximized.
- Closing a prompt with Alt+F4 now means Cancel.

## For administrators

- Files opened while TDPdf runs only go to a TDPdf window of the same account and Windows session.
- Uninstall works when the profile folder name has accented letters or a percent sign.
- Uninstall waits for TDPdf to be closed; a silent `/uninstall` returns 1618, which Intune retries. See `docs/intune-distribution.md`.
- A fresh install from the portable copy asks before adding a desktop shortcut.
- A failed reinstall puts the original program file back.

## Accessibility

- Keyboard focus moves into the Shortcuts overlay and back out when it closes.
- Each group of radio options is one Tab stop; use the arrow keys to move between options.
